title: Kokoro Connect: Michi Random

alternative_titles.ja: ココロコネクト ミチランダム

synopsis:
Not long after putting the previous supernatural incident behind them, the members of Yamaboshi Academy's Student Cultural Society (StuCS) must deal with Fuusenkazura's newest trial—emotion transmission. This phenomenon allows the club members to hear each others' true thoughts, but with one catch: the timing, sender, and recipient are all completely random. To make matters worse, the club's supervisor, Ryuuzen Gotou, may have to step down due to his responsibilities for the upcoming school year. With emotions running high and Valentine's Day around the corner, the seemingly close bonds of the StuCS will be tested when their true feelings for each other are laid bare.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: A Story That Had Already Begun Before Anyone Realized It
episodes_data.description: Being required by their school to be in a club, Yui, Iori, Himeko, Taichi, and Aoki are members of Student Cultural Society. One day, Yui and Aoki  come in with a problem... they claim to have swapped bodies last night.

episodes_data.title: Some Fascinating Humans
episodes_data.description: The Student Cultural Society members have a problem and it seems to be escalating.  The group doesn’t know what to do until a mysterious figure explains almost everything.

episodes_data.title: Jobber and Low Blow
episodes_data.description: As the body switching becomes more common place, the Student Cultural Society members become more adventurous with each other’s body.

episodes_data.title: Twin Feelings
episodes_data.description: Inaban is not well and she has been hiding it from the group.  Taichi, after switching with her, has felt her physical pain and is determined to help her.

episodes_data.title: A Confession and Death......
episodes_data.description: Heartseed has grown bored with the group. So spice things up he takes over Iori body and jumps from a bridge.  He offers the group the ability to switch bodies at will, if one cares to take Iori’s place in death.

episodes_data.title: A Story That Continued Before Anyone Realized It
episodes_data.description: After weeks of peace, the members of the group have started hearing voice and once again their lives have been turned upside down.

episodes_data.title: Falling Apart
episodes_data.description: Acting out on their desires is causing members of the StuCS to lose friends and even turn against each other.

episodes_data.title: And Then There Were None
episodes_data.description: All the infighting between the club members is beginning the boil over.  Good advice comes their way from an unlikely source.

episodes_data.title: Can't Stop Can't Stop Can't Stop
episodes_data.description: The group is learning to be more honest with their desires, except for Inaba.  Heartseed decides to pay her a special visit at home.

episodes_data.title: Putting into Words
episodes_data.description: Heartseed warned Inaba that he would make things interesting. Inaba, Iori, with knives and unleashed desires will leave someone crying.

episodes_data.title: A Story That Began As We Realized It
episodes_data.description: With Heartseed gone the group enjoyed some time off, but a visitor to Taichi is set to stir up new troubles.

episodes_data.title: Into a Snowy City
episodes_data.description: While Kiriyama deals with a friend from the past and the promise she can’t remember.  Aoki must decide who he really loves.

episodes_data.title: As Long as the Five of Us Are Together
episodes_data.description: Taichi screws up and everyone pays the price. While dealing with the situation, Iori gets a call from her mother and the team sets out to help.

specials_data.title: The Days Fall Apart
specials_data.description: The heartseeds put the gang through another emotional rollercoaster as their feelings are able to be transmitted to each other randomly.

specials_data.title: You Don't See It, You Don't Get It
specials_data.description: Iori is hit the hardest by the heartseed and distances herself from the gang. Meanwhile, Himeko and Taichi try to patch things up.

specials_data.title: Determination and Resolution
specials_data.description: The gang must continue on without Iori, but Kaoru tries to sabotage the team. Meanwhile, Iori must come to terms with herself.

specials_data.title: Connecting Hearts
specials_data.description: Himeko gets kidnapped and the others must come to her rescue. Afterwards, the gang learns many things about themselves.
